title: Linearly Convergent Algorithms for Nonsmooth Problems with Unknown Smooth Regions
abstract: arXiv:2507.19465v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop efficient algorithms for optimizing piecewise smooth (PWS) functions when their smooth regions are \emph{unknown} to the algorithm. For convex PWS functions satisfying a quadratic growth (QG) condition, we demonstrate that the bundle-level (BL)-type method~\cite{lemarechal1995new} achieves global linear convergence---to our knowledge, the first such result for any algorithm for this problem class. We extend the method to solve weakly convex PWS problems, achieving the same order of complexity as in smooth non-convex optimization. Furthermore, we introduce a verifiable and accurate termination criterion for PWS optimization. Like the gradient norm in smooth optimization, this certificate tightly characterizes the optimality gap under the QG condition and can be evaluated without knowledge of any problem parameters. translated_title: 针对光滑区域未知的非光滑问题的线性收敛算法
translated_abstract: 我们为优化分片光滑（PWS）函数开发了高效算法，其中其光滑区域对算法而言是未知的。对于满足二次增长（QG）条件的凸分片光滑函数，我们证明了bundle-level（BL）类方法可以实现全局线性收敛——据我们所知，这是该问题类别上任何算法的首个此类结果。我们将该方法扩展到弱凸分片光滑问题，实现了与光滑非凸优化相同量级的复杂度。此外，我们为分片光滑优化引入了一个可验证且精确的终止准则。与光滑优化中的梯度范数类似，该最优性证书在QG条件下紧密刻画了最优性间隙，并且无需知道任何问题参数即可进行评估。我们为该证书开发了一个搜索子程序，并将其嵌入到“猜测-检验”框架中。
tldr: 本文首次证明bundle-level类方法可在光滑区域未知的情况下，对满足二次增长条件的凸分片光滑函数实现全局线性收敛，并将该方法扩展至弱凸分片光滑问题，同时提出了无需任何问题参数的可验证精确终止准则。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first global linear convergence guarantee for bundle-level methods on convex piecewise smooth functions with unknown smooth regions under a quadratic growth condition, extends the approach to weakly convex problems with nonconvex-smooth-level complexity, and introduces a verifiable, parameter-free termination criterion for piecewise smooth optimization.
